what: Public keys no device may be trusted under, as lowercase hex.
why: Ed25519's small-order points. A key of small order is one anybody can produce a valid-looking signature under, so a device filed with one is a device the engine will refuse to talk to. Rust drops such entries when it loads the store; this list is how Go knows the same thing without a curve library, and the tests on both sides read this file so the two cannot drift.
